riskFreeRate.source: U.S. Department of the Treasury — Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates, 10-Year

equityRiskPremium.source: Illustrative long-run historical U.S. equity risk premium (arithmetic average, large-cap equities over long-term Treasury bonds — standard textbook/practitioner reference range). Not a live feed.

costOfDebtSpread.source: Illustrative investment-grade (single-A) credit spread assumption over the risk-free rate (standard practitioner reference range). Not a live feed; combined with riskFreeRate to form a default pre-tax cost of debt where no company-specific bond yield is sourced.

defaultTerminalGrowth.source: Illustrative long-run nominal GDP growth proxy (standard DCF terminal-growth convention). Not a live feed.

defaultBeta.source: Market-average proxy (beta = 1.0) — no per-company beta has been sourced from a reliable provider yet. See project blockers.
